title: Noise probability from Hamming distance
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Under the noise kernel with correlation parameter $1-2\delta$, the probability of obtaining $y$ from $x$ is $\delta^{d(x,y)}(1-\delta)^{n-d(x,y)}$, where $d(x,y)$ is their Hamming distance.
